title: Checking the traveler’s assumption
context: Fictional budget-conscious university student planning a three-day leisure trip. All prices are USD per traveler for the whole trip unless a fact explicitly says otherwise. Travel times are one-way. Only the supplied descriptions count as evidence; no real destinations or prices are represented.

facts.text: Total trip cost is $260, all expenses included.
Music venues are listed; lodging noise level is not documented.
Total trip cost is $285, all expenses included.
Lodging is in a designated quiet zone with a 10 pm noise policy.
Total trip cost is $310, all expenses included.

initial.reasons: Marble Port must be quiet because its name sounds peaceful.

advice.text: Quiet Vale has a documented quiet zone and fits your spending limit.

followups.reasons: I had no evidence that Marble Port was quiet; the documented policy matters to me.
